09/Dated: 12 September, 2024
1.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. The description of land is as follows :-
"Situated at Village - Kujju, Khata No.2, Plot No.2, 4 & 22, Measuring Area - 0.22,
0.15, 0.297 Acres respectively, Total Area - 0.667 Acres, Thana No.154, Aanchal - Mandu, District - Ramgarh."
Suresh Manjhi vs The State Of Jharkhand on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/46500411/
1 3.

It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the matter has already been referred for adjudication before the civil court under the new Land Acquisition Act, i.e., The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013 and as such the present writ petition has become infructuous.
